text:
meera: noticing a spike in 503s from hosted inference for acme-prod starting ~09:10 UTC, customers hitting timeouts. stack shows upstream worker restarts. can someone triage?
alex: on it — seeing repeated container restarts on gpu-node-7, exit code 137 then segfault. attaching short logs: 
alex: ```
[2026-03-18T09:10:12Z] runtime: GPU OOM allocating 1.2GB for KV cache
[2026-03-18T09:10:12Z] infer-runner: signal SIGSEGV (address=0x0)
[2026-03-18T09:10:12Z] infer-runner: coredump saved /var/crash/infer-1234.core
```
chris: reproable on a single request pattern? any recent model swaps?
meera: we rolled a quantized-medium-v2 for acme-prod ~08:50 UTC. low-latency but heavier KV usage.
jamie: initial hypothesis: kv-prefetch memory regression with quant swap + large-context prompts. customers report long prompts (~120k tokens). that could spike KV.
alex: confirmed process RSS jumps before OOM. I can trigger locally with a synthetic long prompt, repro steps below.
alex: ```
# repro (devkit):
curl -X POST https://hosted.redwood/api/generate 
 -d '{"model":"quantized-medium-v2","prompt":"<120k tokens>"}'
# observe rss increase and then SIGSEGV in runtime.c:load_kv()
```
cs_engineer: customer impact — 3a: 1200 requests failed over 6 minutes, several timed out in product. CS notified customers and asked for ETA.
meera: mitigation: enable fallback routing to prioritized-cpu-model for acme-prod and throttle prefetch on that route. can we flip?
oncall-bot: auto-action: routing-policy applied to acme-prod -> prioritized-cpu-model, start_time=2026-03-18T09:15:08Z :white_check_mark:
alex: added temporary hotfix: disable kv-prefetch for quantized-medium-v2 on hosted pool (env KVCACHE_PREFETCH=false). will monitor.
jamie: please also roll back to previous non-quantized variant if prefetch-disable doesn't hold.
chris: collecting more diagnostics: kernel OOM? nvml shows memory fragmented but not full; likely allocator fragmentation from prefetch. attaching nvml snapshot id nvml-7432.
alex: capturing heap profile + core dump uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/7432109999/; correlating with pattern shows spikes when batch size >8 and long prompt prefix exists.
meera: Action items: 1) keep fallback routing active until next deploy. 2) engineering to revert quantized-medium-v2 to prior build and run soak. 3) SRE to add autoscale guard for prefetch memory + batch size cap.
jamie: I'll open a PR to change autoscale config and add a runtime guard (max_prefetch_bytes per worker).
chris: immediate postmortem notes: root cause likely prefetch path not accounting for quantized model's additional temporary buffers — combined with long prompts causes transient allocation > GPU mem -> runtime hit SIGSEGV.
cs_engineer: letting affected customers know we routed traffic and are working on rollback+fix. they asked for ETA for full fix (incl. rollback) — can we give an hour?
alex: rollback queued, CI->canary in 25m, then full in 55m if green. tell CS ~1 hour.
meera: monitoring: 503 rate dropped to baseline after routing change. continuing to watch for restarts.
oncall-bot: uptime-check: routes healthy, 503-rate acme-prod 0.9% -> baseline 0.3% since 09:28 UTC.
jamie: followup: we'll add an eval that exercises long-context prompts on quantized variants in nightly regression to prevent reintroduction.
meera: thanks all. I'll draft incident summary and hand off to postmortem. :thumbsup:
